name: SharpaWave
summary: A 22-DoF, human-proportioned hand built around Sharpa's vision-based 'Dynamic Tactile Array' fingertips. It began shipping in October 2025. The 2026 Wave W02 (IROS 2026) cuts weight to under 750 g with 21 active DoF and adds electronic skin across fingers and palm.

sources.title: Sharpa Robotics Begins Shipping Its SharpaWave Hand — Humanoids Daily
Sharpa Launches D01 Robot, W02 Hand and AE01 Haptic Glove — Humanoids Daily
